name: @linga/frontend-react
comment:build-deps: @tailwindcss/vite, @vitejs/plugin-react, tailwindcss, vite and vite-plugin-singlefile are all imported directly by vite.config.ts and run during `vite build` itself, not only in dev. A production-only install (`npm/yarn install --omit=dev` / `--production`, common on deploy platforms) strips devDependencies and leaves `npm run build` unable to find vite at all, which crashes the server at boot with a misleading 'frontend is missing' error instead of a clear install error. Keeping these as regular dependencies means `npm run build` always has what it needs, regardless of how the host installs packages. typescript/@types/* stay dev-only: the build script is plain `vite build` (esbuild transpiles .tsx without invoking tsc), so they are only needed for editor/type-check tooling.
